## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The check flags a latest-policy artifact modified on a feature branch...

The system SHALL ensure that the check flags a latest-policy artifact modified on a feature branch outside its declared single writer and a fresh-policy artifact copied into a new change from another change, and passes on a clean branch.

#### Scenario: The check flags a latest-policy artifact modified on a feature branch...

WHEN `enforce-fork-policies-in-ci-worktrees-and-sync-points` is implemented
THEN The check flags a latest-policy artifact modified on a feature branch outside its declared single writer and a fresh-policy artifact copied into a new change from another change, and passes on a clean branch.

### Requirement: Worktree setup for a work package creates fresh artifacts empty and does not...

The system SHALL ensure that worktree setup for a work package creates fresh artifacts empty and does not copy latest artifacts into the package branch; a test covers each of the three policies.

#### Scenario: Worktree setup for a work package creates fresh artifacts empty and does not...

WHEN `enforce-fork-policies-in-ci-worktrees-and-sync-points` is implemented
THEN Worktree setup for a work package creates fresh artifacts empty and does not copy latest artifacts into the package branch; a test covers each of the three policies.

### Requirement: The check short-circuits correctly in cloud-harness environments where...

The system SHALL ensure that the check short-circuits correctly in cloud-harness environments where worktree operations are skipped.

#### Scenario: The check short-circuits correctly in cloud-harness environments where...

WHEN `enforce-fork-policies-in-ci-worktrees-and-sync-points` is implemented
THEN The check short-circuits correctly in cloud-harness environments where worktree operations are skipped.

### Requirement: The three sync-point SKILL.md files reference the registry and contain no...

The system SHALL ensure that the three sync-point SKILL.md files reference the registry and contain no locally restated per-artifact fork rules.

#### Scenario: The three sync-point SKILL.md files reference the registry and contain no...

WHEN `enforce-fork-policies-in-ci-worktrees-and-sync-points` is implemented
THEN The three sync-point SKILL.md files reference the registry and contain no locally restated per-artifact fork rules.
